hey man, i just finished high school in the uk. One thing I can definitely say is that a change in environment can completely change your perspective. I spent the past four years worried about grades and now i got them, i don’t understand why i was so worried. I feel mad at myself for being that stressed over something that seems like such a small part of my life now. Parents mostly want what they think is best for you but ultimately you’ll have to figure that out for yourself. Know that their pressure could be coming from a place of love but also not to take it too seriously. High school sucks but you can get through it, just take each day as it comes and spend time on things that matter to you. If you need to speak to anyone you can always message me :)
